acts.label: SIN RECETA
acts.why: She rejects a formula and asks for simple presence: no performance, only come.

acts.label: NO AMOR DE CINE
acts.why: The central hook contrasts theatrical romance with the person who remains after the lights go out.

acts.label: AMOR DE VERDAD
acts.why: The close turns the thesis into a boundary: no invented hours, no disappearing parade, no burning her out.
